tools.description: Record the structured decision for the current task. Every field of the task's answer contract is required; resubmission replaces earlier values.

attendee_count.description: Everyone on the event's attendee list, required and optional, which sets the contingency band and the venue capacity test.

business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

change_fees_usd.description: Sum of the recorded change fees on the changeable itineraries.

changeable_bookings.description: Traveller itineraries that can be re-issued for their recorded change fee.

contingency_usd.description: Events contingency from the policy table for the event's attendee band.

controlled_item_or_record.description: Immutable item, lot set, or transaction record in scope.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

excluded_quantity.description: reserved balance held by open venue-hold deposits and pending adjustments

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Wayfinder's confirmed standard and rush ticketing dates on WF-40460.

new_ticket_cost_usd.description: New tickets multiplied by the group fare on the ticketing confirmation.

new_tickets_required.description: Travellers whose basic fare is forfeited and who need a new ticket at the group fare.

observed_quantity.description: Gross observed quantity before applying the control for funding the engineering all-hands move.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

per_diem_delta_usd.description: Extra billed days times travellers times the venue country's per-diem rate.

quantity_unit.description: Unit of measure for every controlled quantity: USD.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental spend of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing post_adjustment_then_move_to_10_august, move_on_gross_remaining_without_adjustment, displace_byrne_board_meeting_for_27_july.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

source_quantity.description: incremental cost of moving the engineering all-hands to Fennimore Hall's week of 2026-08-10 at agenda rev 3 (change fees, new tickets, venue difference, per-diem difference)

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Wayfinder's confirmed standard and rush ticketing dates on WF-40460.

supported_quantity.description: usable headroom on the engineering events line after reserved deposits and pending adjustments

transaction_quantity.description: Exact quantity the primary state change may persist.

travellers.description: Required attendees whose home office is not the venue's local office (Bristol).

venue_delta_usd.description: Target quote total minus the contracted quote total.
